recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a figure in an ill-fitting, oversized grey suit standing against a repetitive geometric mustard-yellow wallpaper. The composition uses a high-angle gaze and tactile, embroidered-style typography floating in the upper third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the oversized garment and the human frame
Color tension between the cool grey suit and warm mustard background
Textural interplay between flat wallpaper patterns and raised, tactile lettering
Symmetry of the central figure against the busy, rhythmic background pattern
coreInvariants: Oversized grey business suit with long sleeves covering hands
Central vertical alignment of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical axis, scaled to appear slightly dwarfed by the environment.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, positioned at the vertical center, looking upward toward the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze upward to the title text, then expands outward to the patterned wallpaper and surrounding domestic props.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by the wallpaper pattern, providing a canvas for the floating typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow (background wallpaper and furniture accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, vintage-inspired saturation with soft, diffused lighting that minimizes harsh shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Mimics hand-stitched embroidery or burnt-in texture
Connected lowercase letters with slight 'ink-bleed' or 'thread-fray' edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a rounded, slightly open loop
Lowercase 'f' with a soft, elongated crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style textured script to maintain a DIY, personal aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Indoor plants (palm and fern) framing the edges

preserve: Textured, tactile feel of the letters

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, hand-made quality of the original lettering.
Matches the tactile, 'stitched' appearance of the text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A woman with dark curly hair wearing a very oversized grey suit and lavender tie, standing in a room with 1970s mustard yellow geometric wallpaper. She is looking upwards. Include a palm plant on the left and a wooden shelf on the right. Soft, vintage film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, lowercase, dark brown textured script in the upper third of the image. The text should look like it is embroidered or burnt into the wallpaper.

verificationChecks: Is the suit visibly too large for the subject?
Is the wallpaper pattern consistent and retro in style?
Does the text have a tactile, non-digital texture?
Is the subject's gaze directed toward the text?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the lavender tie
Density of the tactile texture on the lettering
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Exact brand logos on the props
Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hands are mostly hidden by the suit sleeves.
Check that the wallpaper pattern does not overwhelm the subject.
Verify the text is legible despite its textured treatment.
Confirm the color palette remains within the mustard/grey/lavender range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Oversized Corporate Attire] + [Retro Geometric Interior] + [Tactile Hand-Stitched Typography] to create a visual narrative of [Personal Growth/Awkwardness].
